column1: imfhigh_title;High International Monetary Fund Interest rates;;;;;;;;;;;;x

imfhigh_desc;High International Monetary Fund Interest rates can greatly increase our nation's income from the loans that we have given to other nations but it can also garner the ire of the other members of the IMF who rely heavily on the loans.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
imfmedium_title;Medium International Monetary Fund Interest rates;;;;;;;;;;;;x

imfmedium_desc;Medium International Monetary Fund Interest rates can modestly increase our nation's income from the loans that we have given to other nations while can also avoiding the ire of the other members of the IMF who rely heavily on the loans.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
imflow_title;Low International Monetary Fund Interest rates;;;;;;;;;;;;x

imflow_desc;Low International Monetary Fund Interest rates can greatly dimish our nation's income from the loans that we have given to other nations but it can also boost the relations between the other members of the IMF who rely heavily on the loans and us.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
wtohigh_desc;High World Trade Organisation Tarrifs can stifle global trade but if we need some quick income this is the best solution. Not everyone will like us for doing this though.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

wtomedium_desc;Medium World Trade Organisation Tariffs will not significantly affect our country's trade and even global trade for that matter but it will also not give us a relation boost with the other WTO member states.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

wtolow_desc;Low World Trade Organisation Tarrifs can significantly affect our tariff income but it can also give a significant boost to global trade. The WTO nations that love trade will definitely love us as well;;;;;;;;;;;;x
ibrdhigh_title;High International Bank for Reconstruction & Development Member aid;;;;;;;;;;;;x

ibrdhigh_desc;High International Bank for Reconstruction & Development Member aid helps boost developing nation economic growth and increase our relations with them though it comes at the cost of those states eventually out growing us in the future.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
ibrdmedium_title;Medium International Bank for Reconstruction & Development Member aid;;;;;;;;;;;;x

ibrdmedium_desc;Medium International Bank for Reconstruction & Development Member aid does not significantly affect the economic growth of the developing nations and does not help us get a realtions boost as well.;;;;;;;;;;;;x
ibrdlow_title;Low International Bank for Reconstruction & Development Member aid;;;;;;;;;;;;x

ibrdlow_desc;Low International Bank for Reconstruction & Development Member aid negatively affects the economic growth of the developing nations but helps us to keep our economic lead over them. The developing nations will not like us for doing so though.;;;;;;;;;;;;x

America is now the world hegemon. However it will not last long in this new multi-polar world with the rise of new centers of power in the ambitious and populace east. China and India are aspiring to seize the top spot to end the American hegemony though soft and hard power. With globalisation and the shift in geopolitical power towards the east
column2: this is increasingly not a matter of if but when. In this renewed competitive multipolar world
column3: nations will join what are initially trade blocs
column4: and eventually in some cases large centralised union states like the European Union
column5: the South American Union and the African Union. All the while new conflicts ignite over the shattered remains of the eastern bloc. In light of these developments
column6: the end of the Cold War can hardly have said to deliver the decisive realisation of international peace but it still has profundly altered our world and whether it is for the better or worse is up to you. This is the beginning of the New World Order.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
